prompt:
Produce a concise advisory implementation PLAN ONLY for the following EmpireOS task. Do not edit files, emit deployment commands, perform production actions, contact external parties, mutate databases, move funds, or expand authority. Identify affected modules, focused tests, main risks, dependencies, and approval gates.

TASK:
EMPIREOS — BUILD FIRST-CLASS OUTBOUND DEPARTMENT V1

ENGINEERING MODE:
ARCHITECTURE-FIRST.
PLAN BEFORE IMPLEMENT.
OBSERVE / INTERNAL ENGINEERING ONLY.
NO LIVE SEND.
NO DB MIGRATION.
NO PRODUCTION DB WRITE.
NO SERVICE/TIMER RESTART.
NO DEPLOY.
NO COMMIT.
NO AUTHORITY EXPANSION.

MISSION

Build and integrate a proper first-class Outbound Department into the existing
EmpireOS architecture.

The department's purpose is NOT simply "send cold emails".

Its commercial operating model is:

VERIFIED PROSPECT
→ RESEARCH
→ RELEVANCE
→ RAPPORT
→ VALUE
→ NURTURE
→ ENGAGEMENT
→ CONVERSATION
→ EXISTING CLOSER
→ EXISTING COMMERCIAL PROCESS

ASTRA ROLE

Astra is the intelligence/director brain for the Outbound Department.

Astra should determine the next best permitted action from bounded states such as:

RESEARCH
WAIT
DRAFT_RAPPORT_TOUCH
DRAFT_VALUE_TOUCH
DRAFT_NURTURE_TOUCH
DRAFT_SOFT_CONVERSATION_OPENER
HANDOFF_TO_CLOSER
SUPPRESS
BLOCK

Astra MUST NOT:
- grant itself send authority
- bypass governance
- bypass suppression
- bypass personhood/contact-route rules
- create commercial terms
- recognize revenue
- move funds

Astra intelligence proposes.
Deterministic governance authorizes.
Existing outbound execution sends only when separately authorized.

======================================================
REUSE BEFORE BUILDING
======================================================

Inspect exact current owners before proposing modifications.

At minimum inspect where present:

AGENTS.md
docs/ARCHITECTURE_FIRST_ENGINEERING_DOCTRINE.md
docs/BLUEPRINT_V6.md

empire_os/departments.py
empire_os/department_cycle.py
empire_os/astra.py
empire_os/astra_executive.py
empire_os/astra_feedback.py
empire_os/astra_observer.py
empire_os/astra_intelligence_routing.py
empire_os/outreach_message_optimizer.py
empire_os/adaptive_outreach_optimizer.py
empire_os/gtm_pipeline_worker.py
empire_os/outbound_governor.py
empire_os/outbound_followup_worker.py
empire_os/outbound_role_transport.py
empire_os/buyer_review_materializer.py
empire_os/conversation_value.py
empire_os/conversation_timeline.py
empire_os/conversation_qualification.py
empire_os/closer_reply_worker.py
empire_os/gmail_reply_adapter.py
empire_os/outcome_feedback.py
empire_os/economic_memory.py

Trace real imports and callers.
Do not assume a filename is the canonical owner.

DO NOT create another:
- sender
- CRM
- reply ledger
- conversation store
- Economic Memory
- scheduler
- adaptive optimizer
- outbound governor
- mailbox provider
- revenue engine

======================================================
OUTBOUND SPECIALIST ROLES
======================================================

Coordinate bounded specialist responsibilities equivalent to:

OUTBOUND DIRECTOR
ACCOUNT RESEARCH
RAPPORT / MESSAGING
NURTURE / NEXT-BEST-TOUCH
DELIVERABILITY REVIEW
REPLY INTELLIGENCE
CONVERSATION HANDOFF
OUTREACH LEARNING
GOVERNANCE

Do not create uncontrolled recursive agents.

======================================================
RELATIONSHIP STATE
======================================================

Design deterministic states equivalent to:

COLD_VERIFIED
RAPPORT_STARTED
RAPPORT_BUILDING
VALUE_ESTABLISHED
ENGAGED
CONVERSATION
COMMERCIAL_READY
SUPPRESSED

Derive state from real evidence.

Use:
- buyer review
- verified company/person evidence
- contact route
- outbound history
- replies
- conversation evidence
- suppression state
- existing commercial qualification

UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN.

======================================================
RAPPORT-FIRST COLD EMAIL
======================================================

This is critical.

Cold email is allowed as a channel.

Cold pitching immediately is NOT the strategy.

Touch 1:
- relevance
- recognition
- genuine evidence-backed observation
- human tone
- NO hard CTA
- NO pricing
- NO demo request
- NO meeting request
- NO calendar link

Touch 2:
- genuinely new value
- new evidence or angle
- no repeated primary observation

Touch 3:
- deepen relevance/familiarity
- another distinct useful insight

Only after VALUE_ESTABLISHED may the department PROPOSE a soft conversational CTA.

Example later-stage CTA:
"If this is something you're actively looking at, I can show you what we're seeing."

Even then execution authority remains NONE until governed approval.

======================================================
NO AI SLOP — HARD BLOCKING POLICY
======================================================

Generic AI-generated marketing language is BARRED.

This must be a hard acceptance gate, not a soft style score.

Block conditions should include equivalents of:

GENERIC_OPENER
EMPTY_PERSONALIZATION
AI_SLOP_PHRASE
UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM
FAKE_FAMILIARITY
REPEATED_INSIGHT
PREMATURE_CTA
PREMATURE_PRICE
ROLE_INBOX_PERSONHOOD_CLAIM
UNVERIFIED_COMPANY_SHORTENING

Bar phrases/patterns such as:

"I hope this email finds you well"
"just reaching out"
"just following up"
"checking in"
"touching base"
"circling back"
"bumping this"
"unlock growth"
"leverage AI"
"revolutionise"
"revolutionize"
"game-changing"
"transform your business"
"synergies"

Do not simply maintain a phrase blacklist.
Also detect structural genericness.

Specificity rule:

If changing only the company name would leave the email equally applicable to
100 other companies, the message is NOT sufficiently personalised.

Use evidence before adjectives.

Human founder voice:
- plain English
- short
- natural
- specific
- confident
- no bloated corporate copy
- one primary idea per touch

======================================================
COMPANY NAME RULE
======================================================

Early cold outreach must use the FULL VERIFIED COMPANY NAME.

Example:

"Intercept Roofing & Construction"

DO NOT casually shorten it to:

"Intercept"

unless one of the following is true:

1. the company's own first-party material verifies that as its active public brand;
2. the prospect themselves uses the shorter form in conversation;
3. canonical verified evidence explicitly establishes the shortened trading name.

Once rapport exists, natural references such as:
"your team"
"your business"
"your Nashville operation"

are preferable to inventing a nickname.

Create a hard blocker equivalent to:

UNVERIFIED_COMPANY_SHORTENING

======================================================
PERSON / ROLE INBOX RULE
======================================================

For:

info@
sales@
office@
hello@
contact@

contact_route remains company_routed.
person_bound remains false.

A named decision-maker can be the intended routing target without pretending
the mailbox belongs personally to that person.

Allowed style where appropriate:

"Hi — this is for Trace Finch."

Not allowed:

"Trace, I found your email..."

when the route is info@ or another company inbox.

======================================================
EVIDENCE GATE
======================================================

Every factual personalised claim requires evidence_ref.

Evidence must support:
- the exact account/company
- the stated observation
- source/provenance
- freshness where applicable
- verification/confidence state where available

Missing/stale/contradictory evidence:
→ RESEARCH / WAIT / BLOCK

Never fabricate the next nurture insight.

======================================================
REPLY-FIRST BRANCHING
======================================================

A genuine reply immediately outranks a scheduled nurture step.

INTEREST
→ existing conversation/closer

QUESTION
→ existing conversation/closer

OBJECTION
→ existing objection/conversation handling

WRONG PERSON / REFERRAL
→ identity/contact next action

OOO
→ wait/retry recommendation

UNSUBSCRIBE
→ suppression
→ stop all nurture

No timer-based message may override a real reply.

======================================================
RELATIONSHIP MEMORY
======================================================

Reuse existing canonical conversation/outreach memory.

Each account decision needs awareness of:

- who they are
- full verified company name
- verified decision-maker
- contact route
- person_bound
- why they were selected
- evidence already used
- messages already sent
- primary angles already used
- reply history
- objections/questions
- current relationship stage
- next permitted action

Do NOT create another durable CRM or reply store.

======================================================
LEARNING
======================================================

Integrate strategy metadata so existing learning can eventually associate:

strategy_id
relationship_stage
touch_number
touch_purpose
evidence_refs
message_angle
contact_route
result

with verified downstream outcomes.

Do NOT treat:
- opens
- clicks
- replies
- meetings

as recognized revenue.

Only existing verified commercial outcome pathways may reach Economic Memory.

======================================================
DELIVERABILITY
======================================================

Reuse existing Outbound Governor / deliverability architecture.

The department may require a deliverability check.

It does not grant send permission itself.

======================================================
PUBLIC PLANNING API
======================================================

Determine whether the correct owning implementation is a new coordinator such as:

empire_os/outbound_department.py

or an extension to an existing canonical owner.

Prefer extension if an owner already exists.

Desired pure planning capability equivalent to:

plan_outbound_account(
    account,
    history=(),
    evidence=(),
    replies=(),
    suppressions=(),
    now=None,
) -> dict

It must be deterministic and side-effect-free.

Output should include equivalents of:

department_key
prospect_id
review_id
relationship_stage
action_type
reason
evidence_refs
used_evidence_refs
missing_evidence
contact_route
person_bound
touch_number
touch_purpose
strategy_id
cta_allowed
price_allowed
automated_nurture_allowed
deliverability_check_required
authority_required
execution_authority

execution_authority must remain none in this slice.

======================================================
INTERCEPT ACCEPTANCE SHAPE
======================================================

Test an equivalent input:

company:
Intercept Roofing & Construction

decision maker:
Trace Finch
Owner

route:
info@interceptroofing.com

contact_route:
company_routed

person_bound:
false

buyer review:
pending

prior outbound:
none

With one fresh account-bound verified insight:

EXPECTED:
COLD_VERIFIED
rapport/value first-touch proposal
full name "Intercept Roofing & Construction"
CTA false
price false
execution_authority none
person_bound false
no claim that info@ belongs personally to Trace Finch

With no verified insight:

EXPECTED:
RESEARCH or BLOCK
no fabricated message

======================================================
REQUIRED TEST CONTRACT
======================================================

Plan focused tests proving at least:

1 first touch blocks CTA
2 first touch blocks pricing
3 first touch blocks meeting/calendar request
4 evidence required for specific claims
5 stale evidence blocked
6 unsupported claims blocked
7 generic AI copy blocked
8 generic opener blocked
9 AI-slop phrase blocked
10 repeated insight blocked
11 touch 2 requires new value
12 soft CTA blocked before VALUE_ESTABLISHED
13 soft CTA may only be proposed after legitimate relationship state
14 soft CTA proposal still execution_authority none
15 real reply stops nurture
16 opt-out suppresses
17 OOO does not create sales escalation
18 company_routed stays person_bound false
19 role inbox cannot be claimed as personal
20 full company name required early
21 unverified shortening blocked
22 prospect's own verified shortening can later be mirrored
23 suppression outranks nurture
24 conversation cannot restart as cold
25 strategy metadata survives
26 UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN
27 deterministic output
28 zero network/DB/send side effects
29 no payment/terms/revenue authority
30 exactly one canonical outbound department owner
31 Astra proposes but cannot grant send authority
32 existing Outbound Governor authority remains unchanged
33 existing sender/approver separation remains unchanged
34 full-name Intercept acceptance case passes
35 no-evidence Intercept acceptance case blocks safely

Also identify and run all relevant adjacent existing regression tests.

======================================================
ARCHITECTURE DELIVERABLE
======================================================

Produce an architecture-first implementation plan that identifies:

- exact canonical owner(s)
- files inspected
- files to reuse
- exact files requiring modification
- any new file genuinely required
- department registry integration
- Astra integration
- relationship-state integration
- message quality / NO_AI_SLOP gate integration
- reply/closer integration
- learning integration
- tests
- negative tests
- authority invariants
- no-duplicate proof

The PLAN must produce the exact bounded promotion requirements for IMPLEMENT.

If promotion is appropriate, specify a promotion_contract with:

kind=IMPLEMENT
authority=internal_write
exact allowed_paths
exact lease_resources
exact required_tests
exact success condition

Do NOT invent execution_plane_request_id.
Identify the canonical source for it.
If one cannot be established, report that as the precise remaining blocker.

No production action is performed by this PLAN.
